row.evidence: Hippo Video's OneLogin SCIM guide says 'To activate de=provisioning you need a Hippo Video Enterprise plan', and the pricing page lists Enterprise at $80/month/user (annually) with a 10-seat minimum.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Plans (sales pricing page): Free $0, Pro $20/u/mo annual ($30 monthly), Teams $60/u/mo annual ($75 monthly), Enterprise $80/u/mo annual, minimum 10 seats (adds SSO and role-based access); a separate pricing link covers marketing/support/SDK use cases. SCIM v2 is Enterprise-only and documented only for OneLogin's generic 'SCIM Provisioner with SAML (SCIM v2)' app: the SCIM URL is shown on the SSO Configuration page once 'Enable de-provisioning' is on, and the bearer token must be requested from support. Price gate decides status (rule 1); with only one IdP documented it would otherwise be partial. Okta and Entra are documented as custom SAML apps only; no OIN app. Deactivated users lose access but their assets are kept.

operations.notes: OneLogin is set to create, update and delete without admin approval; the guide's stated purpose is automatic de-provisioning of licenses. Whether a OneLogin 'delete' deactivates or deletes the Hippo Video user is not stated, so delete stays null and update is not split into PUT/PATCH.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated users keep their assets (UI deactivation)
deprovision.notes: frees_seat from 'automatic de-provisioning of licenses'. The data-retention text describes UI deactivation; the guide does not say whether SCIM deprovisioning deactivates or deletes.

limitations.text: Only a OneLogin setup is documented; the SCIM URL appears on the SSO Configuration page and the bearer token must be requested from support.

scim.notes: The SCIM base URL is shown in the app (SSO Configuration card) and is not published; endpoints, attributes, filtering and rate limits are not documented.

auth.notes: Sign-up API needs a client ID and client secret issued on request. Other APIs use a per-user API key (profile settings) exchanged for an authentication token at /api/v1/me/auth, default expiry 1 month.

endpoints.purpose: Sign-up API: create a user account (client_id, client_secret, email, optional password)

user_api.notes: The documented API covers sign-up, video library, reports and personalisation; no list/update/deactivate user endpoints are documented. Marked partner_only because user creation needs client credentials obtained from Hippo Video.

okta.notes: No OIN app; Hippo Video's guide creates a custom SAML 2.0 app integration (Enterprise plan).

entra.notes: Custom non-gallery SAML app per Hippo Video's guide; hippo-video-tutorial on Learn returns 404.

onelogin.notes: Uses OneLogin's generic 'SCIM Provisioner with SAML (SCIM v2)' template, from Hippo Video's own guide (OneLogin catalogue not loaded).
